name: TrafficCone
notes: 0.59 m cone; two white bands; weighted rubber base. White material is not a simulated retroreflector.

name: SafetyBarrier
notes: Freestanding striped barrier with two weighted feet, rear panel and fasteners.

name: HardHat
notes: Hollow double-wall shell, broad brim, suspension band and three crown ridges. Decorative prop, not safety equipment.

name: Wheelbarrow
notes: Open teal tray, tubular undercarriage, treaded wheel, two support legs and rubber grips; static assembly.

name: Shovel
notes: Curved steel blade, timber shaft, orange D grip and black grip sleeve.

name: CementBag
notes: Soft filled kraft sack with folded ends, geometric stitches and original DRY MIX / 25 marking; no brand.

name: Toolbox
notes: Orange protective case, dark ribbed lid, steel latches, rear hinges and raised carry handle. Lid is not animated.

name: RoadSign
notes: Weighted-base diamond direction sign with original generic arrow graphic. Not a certified jurisdiction-specific traffic sign.

name: PortableWorkLight
notes: Twin LED-style heads on a telescopic tripod; emissive material included. No real-time Light component or cable physics.

name: BrickStack
notes: 18 individually editable bricks with chamfered edges and inset frogs, arranged in three layers.

name: RebarBundle
notes: Six ribbed 2 m steel bars in triangular packing, two ties and two timber dunnage blocks; static assembly.

name: CautionSign
notes: Double-sided folding A-frame sign with an open carry handle, rubber feet and original CAUTION marking; static assembly.
